newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-CSFB starts OTE coverage.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CSFB starts OTE coverage.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston said on Thursday it was starting coverage of Hellenic Telecommunications Organisation SA (OTE) with a "hold" recommendation.
It forecast earnings per share (EPS) for OTE of 492 drachmas in 1997 and 527 drachmas in 1998.
"A favourable competitive situation and a positive outlook for pricing and volume growth are the main components of the OTE investment story," Credit Suisse said in a research note.
"These features should continue to be OTE's main determinants for sustainable cash flow and earnings growth, plus above average returns."
It said OTE was expected to continue to generate above-average revenue and earnings growth because of its monopoly position, tariff rebalancing, network modernisation and efficiency improvements.
But it said the sharp appreciation in the company's share price "makes it one of the most expensive telecom stocks in Europe with our valuation indicating limited upside from current levels".
